positions.commentary: The speaker notes that some investors sold Amazon at the wrong time and have never bought it again, but argues one should always be willing to look at the whole universe of opportunities fresh.

thesis: This episode argues that investors who sold Amazon at the wrong time and never repurchased it made a mistake, and that one should always be willing to look at the entire universe of investment opportunities fresh.
